notes: Party upgrades (Plan 6c, design §4 "Party upgrades"): lasting purchases owned by the party, bought level by level (I–V) wherever a service in `soldBy` is. Level n costs basePrice × n gp (designer call 2026-11-13: a normal base is 100, the company banner's 200). What each level does is the engine's (src/engine/rules/upgrades.ts, numbers in the constants' "Party upgrades" section); `description` is flavour, and the game adds what each level does. Guild membership was dropped (designer call 2026-11-13).

entries.name: Camp kit
entries.description: Oiled canvas, good bedrolls, a proper pot and the know-how to pitch it all before dark.

entries.name: Smuggler's compartment
entries.description: False bottoms, sewn-in pockets and a hollow pack frame, made by people who don't ask why.

entries.name: Surveyor's maps
entries.description: Copied survey sheets, field notes on where the old roads ran, and a good compass.

entries.name: Delving gear
entries.description: Rope, pitons, hooded lanterns, chalk and a ten-foot pole: the kit of people who come back out.

entries.name: Company banner
entries.description: A banner, matching cloaks and a name sewn on both: something to stand under when it goes badly.
